name: The European Avant-Garde: From Impressionism to Cubism
description: ★ Rating: 6/10 🎭 Formal Qualities – Fourteen works by artists including Monet, Pissarro, Gauguin, Kandinsky, and Picasso make a compact survey of changing approaches to color, space, and composition. The exhibition’s stated arc, from Monet’s studies of light…
